references.text: The City of Palms (Jericho) is also mentioned here as the city Moses saw from Mount Nebo
The City of Palms is identified with Jericho, where the Kenites settled
Amalek is mentioned as Israel's enemy in Balaam's prophecy
Amalek's hostility toward Israel and the command to remember their wickedness
The Ammonites and the Amalekites are again mentioned as oppressors of Israel
The Ammonites continued to be enemies of Israel in Jephthah's time
Amalek's first attack on Israel after leaving Egypt
